profile.name: 光纤光谱仪
profile.description: 这是一种用于采集光谱信号的光纤光谱仪，可在设定积分时间后测量样品或光源的强度随波长分布。实验室中常用于发射光谱、吸收光谱、荧光光谱及一般光学表征。
profile.description_en: This is a fiber optic spectrometer used to acquire optical spectra by measuring intensity as a function of wavelength with a configurable integration time. In laboratories it is commonly used for emission, absorption, fluorescence, and general optical characterization.

registry.name: Ocean Insight
registry.description: Ocean Insight 微型光纤光谱仪是由Ocean Insight (Ocean Optics)生产的表征设备，主要功能包括关闭、加载、打开、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot等操作。
